scope: Havenwild native editor and in-game F3 developer authoring shell

principles.singleWindowAuthority: All native editor workspaces share one persistent shell/chrome contract rather than inventing workspace-local window geometry.
principles.actualDrawableArea: Layout calculations use the actual current drawable width/height. No synthetic minimum window size may push panels outside the OS window.
principles.canvasPriority: Project and inspector panels may compress when space is constrained so the center canvas remains usable. Persisted panel widths are preferences, not permission to overflow the window.
principles.overflowPolicy: Any panel whose controls exceed its visible content rectangle must use bounded scrolling, pagination, tabs, or collapsible sections. Controls may never become unreachable below or beside the window.
principles.controlLabels: Buttons and tabs must keep labels inside their bounds using clipping/ellipsis or adaptive sizing; labels may not draw across neighboring controls.
principles.fixedStatus: The status bar remains fixed to the shell edge. Bottom panels overlay/dock without causing canvas geometry to jump unexpectedly.
principles.persistentProjectPanel: The normal authoring shell keeps the project/browser lane on the left and selection/property inspection on the right when those panels are enabled.
principles.inputOwnership: Chrome, panels, splitters, dialogs, and canvas each own input only inside their visible bounds. Hidden or clipped controls may not remain clickable.
principles.f3IsLightweight: F3 is a runtime authoring/debug overlay, not a duplicate of the full native editor. Expensive diagnostics are opt-in and normal rendering caches remain active unless the selected tool requires live per-cell terrain state.

requiredFutureNormalization: Add a shared bounded-scroll container for long inspectors and property sheets.
Migrate Pixel Studio Grid/Asset inspector, Animation inspector, Character inspector, object/property inspectors, and asset intake panels to the shared overflow container.
Normalize section spacing, row heights, field label columns, disabled/hover/focus states, and keyboard focus traversal project-wide.
Persist desired dock sizes while deriving safe effective sizes from the current drawable area.
Keep workspace tabs responsive and reachable at reduced window widths.
